## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Jul 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _zac-attac_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "I have paid for the Notion Plus subscription for some time. I was worried when they introduced AI features but I stuck with it because I liked the product and they had been good so far. I regret that now. The app is still horrible and slow on mobile, nearly as bad on desktop, buggy, doesn’t give power users the features they need. STILL I paid for my subscription even though the app never improved. But today is the straw that broke the camel’s back: I pay for Plus but I can’t retrieve document versions older than 90 days without paying even MORE for an Enterprise plan? I’m going to be getting my things off this platform as soon as possible. I can’t support this anymore. If the app gets overhauled, I’ll check in again. But I can’t put up with no improvements AND being nickel-and-dimed for basic features that should be included in my subscription. You had a great idea and you’ve run it into the ground."
            2. _Broken app garbage_, Jul 16, 2026, 1/5: "Each update makes the app slower. Critical features get hidden behind AI features - like search. IOS widgets are super buggy. The share widget is completely broken. The app is unusable at some points."
            3. _Smh.17_, Jul 14, 2026, 1/5: "The application has a bug when I want to take templates that are already made, it doesn't work, I press it, it doesn't open"
